name: Paradisus Los Cabos
positioning: Adults-only, all-inclusive beach resort in San José del Cabo with mission-style architecture, officially called Paradisus Los Cabos - Adults Only, with a separate The Reserve tier
best_for: Adult couples who want an all-inclusive stay with direct beach access
Travelers who want swim-up suites and private-lounge service through The Reserve

facts.text: The resort is at kilometre 19.5 of the Carretera Transpeninsular in San José del Cabo, Baja California Sur.
The resort has direct access to the beach.
The hotel is a member of The Leading Hotels of the World.
The cuisine includes traditional Mexican dishes inspired by the sea and prepared with locally sourced ingredients.
Cappella is an open-air a la carte Italian restaurant serving home-made pasta, wood-fired pizza and fresh salads.
Agua Marina is a beachfront restaurant for open-air meals with sea views.
YHI Spa has individual and couples treatment cabins, a sauna, a leisure pool, a beauty salon, a relaxation area and a fully equipped gym.
YHI Spa treatments are made with local ingredients and essential oils.
Activities include Latin dance, sushi, art and mixology classes plus wine and cheese and tequila and mezcal tastings.
Evenings bring live music, resident DJs and theme parties.
The Reserve Lounge offers The Reserve guests private check-in and check-out.

highlights.text: The resort features traditional mission-style architecture, works of art and touches inspired by local culture.
The Reserve Suite Swim Up King has direct access to a private pool.
At Tokimeku, sushi is served in western and Asian style, in a private dining room, on a Zen terrace or at the sushi counter.
Sound healing sessions with bowls are held by the sea or in the gardens.
Santé overlooks the Sea of Cortez.

considerations.text: SAL Steak Cave is not included in the all-inclusive plan.
Some experiences are reserved for The Reserve guests: breakfast and lunch at Santé, and an offsite chocolate factory tour with a walk through San José del Cabo's old town.
The resort's adults program is for guests over 18 years of age.
